cases.title: Modal focus and backdrop
cases.expected: Cell styles reflect correct backdrop/surface, dimensions60/88/116 constrained by width; Esc restores draft/focus and does not quit app. Successful agent selection closes Select agent, restores prompt draft/focus and updates actual selection/metadata without an agent-selection success toast, matching pinned upstream; verify paired before/after full frames and the selected agent while preserving error feedback and unrelated existing warnings. In an existing multi-message session, hovering the user message changes only its block as upstream; mouse-up without selected text opens the matching Message Actions dialog, text selection does not. Jump to dismisses for the already visible message. Owner amendment 2026-09-26: Revert moves the active conversation/LLM-context boundary before the selected user message and refills the prompt, never restoring files; /undo targets the last preceding nonempty-text user message, and all Redo entry points clear the entire staged boundary and restore the saved tail without provider calls or tool reexecution, matching original clear-all behavior per VIS33 and superseding the earlier one-turn Redo exception. Raw history is retained, DCP summaries/pruning obey the restored context version, restart retains the boundary, and a new accepted prompt after undo invalidates normal redo of the old tail. Workspace content/modes and user Git index/HEAD remain unchanged; snapshots default off, snapshot:false and snapshots:false are accepted, true reports unsupported. Copy requests a clipboard write with the exact message text (verify the destination separately where supported, per VIS27), Fork creates a real session before that user message with the prompt restored. Paired normal/hover/dialog styled-cell and PNG frames against original with snapshots disabled plus post-action session/context, unchanged-workspace and clipboard evidence are required. Missing owner actions cannot be represented by inert menu entries.

cases.title: Tool cards and partial patch
cases.expected: Live real operation events create correctly ordered cards/hunks/error/unknown/truncation. Incomplete/partial patch is never displayed as full success. Eligible Explored groups and long-output Shell blocks match upstream normal/hover/click-expanded/second-click-recollapsed full styled-cell and PNG frames, including scroll and actual recorded output after reopen; hover only highlights. Ordinary Read does not falsely offer full-file expansion and an upstream/tool-truncated result is not presented as recoverable data. Successful completed Shell tool cards omit synthesized exit-zero status and match upstream's one-row bordered command/output gap when output is non-empty, without a phantom separator for empty output. Verify one-line/multiline/empty output in paired full frames and replay/reopen; retain actual process output, recorded exit/output metadata and visible abnormal outcomes. Update the existing divergent Shell golden.

cases.title: Durable replay parity
cases.expected: Same session parts/cards/metadata render equivalently after page reload, session switch and process restart, with one durable owner. For a fresh session with a non-default profile and no explicit profile switch, the first user stripe matches pinned upstream during streaming, after completion/durable page replacement and after reopen. Both actual user and assistant message IDs retain the correct turn association and agent/color metadata; verify a real completed turn and history query, not synthetic rows or a renderer fallback. Paired full styled-cell/PNG frames and two sequential outgoing provider requests must show unchanged selected agent ID/digest (owner selection/log evidence) and that profile's instruction input, with no silent default-Build substitution under unchanged profile/config. No hard-coded profile/color or new immutable historical-color rule across explicit profile switches. UI color and stable profile instructions do not establish provider KV-cache reuse; do not publish credentials or raw live responses.

Paired original/native styled-cell/PNG frames for trigger, filtered query and after Tab; skills/non-primary agent sections are deferred (T45) supported differences, not passed.

cases.title: Mouse selection and upstream clipboard feedback
cases.expected: Under the same terminal profile, original and native select mode: a mouse-up marked isDragging copies nonempty selected text, including word/line selection by repeated clicks without pointer movement; empty or ordinary non-drag release does not copy. Manual mode: right-button mouse-down copies an existing nonempty selection. Copy retains the highlight. A successful clipboard write shows the info toast 'Copied to clipboard'; failure does not show a success toast. Verify event/selection behavior and paired toast frames in PTY; separately verify the clipboard destination where supported. A toast frame alone does not prove that an external system clipboard received the text.

cases.title: Running agent indicator in lower-left prompt footer
cases.expected: In a real running session the lower-left footer, below agent/model metadata and before 'esc interrupt', shows the pinned eight-cell agent-colored blocks/trail scanner. With animations enabled, paired original/native temporal captures show forward motion, end hold, reverse motion and start hold at the nominal 40 ms frame cadence; compare matched phases, not unrelated wall-clock frames. With animations disabled both show '[⋯]' beside the interrupt hint. On completion or interruption the running indicator disappears. Metadata labels remain data-driven; a static spinner or an animation-off-only capture cannot pass this case.

cases.title: Ctrl+T cycles active model variants
cases.expected: In a real PTY, Ctrl+T cycles the active model from default through only its dynamically declared named variants in pinned upstream order and back to default. The selection is visible and persists according to upstream behavior, without changing model or sending a request on the shortcut; the next accepted prompt uses the selected variant in the provider request, including reasoning.effort when that model variant declares it. No named variants means Ctrl+T is a no-op. Paired original/native styled-cell frames and request/persistence evidence are required; no hard-coded variant names or levels.

cases.title: Sessions metadata and actions parity
cases.expected: The Sessions dialog uses real stored root-session titles with upstream fallback instead of router IDs, groups/orders by truthful update time with Today/date labels, and matches conditional project context, search and current marker. Paired full styled-cell/PNG frames cover named sessions on multiple days, search, selection, Esc and reopen. Missing legacy last-update data requires an evidenced migration/fallback decision before parity closure; never infer dates from IDs or label creation time as update time.

cases.title: Demand-driven high-refresh rendering and idle efficiency
cases.expected: On the actual binary through PTY, wait for input, worker updates and real active-animation deadlines; do not unconditionally poll or draw. Paint only dirty visible state, coalescing bursts while bounding work so input, worker events and paints progress. After the view and pending deadlines settle, a stable idle interval has no periodic redraws or wakeups; the upstream scanner cadence remains independent of render pacing. Record measurement window, render attempts, changed frames/terminal writes, event-to-paint latency distribution, draw/write durations, queue behavior, wakeups and process CPU time. Exercise active changes with requested 6.06 ms (165 Hz) and faster frame budgets where measured render and terminal costs permit. A configured/requested cadence is not measured FPS or proof of physical terminal refresh. Set numeric latency/CPU thresholds from a recorded baseline; do not infer FPS from draw duration or configuration alone.

cases.title: Responsive wheel scrolling and live viewport anchoring
cases.expected: In the cell-based Crossterm path, preserve wheel displacement and pinned upstream default speed semantics where the protocol permits; inspect the pinned MacOSScrollAccel implementation before claiming its acceleration parity. Bound input work and coalesce compatible wheel bursts without losing displacement, changing direction/boundary semantics, starving paints/workers or replaying stale input as a long catch-up. While the target offset is unsettled, animate toward it using active frame deadlines only, promptly rebase on reversed input and stop scheduling when settled. Motion remains row-quantized; directional wheel events do not provide pixel scroll deltas. While scrolled away from bottom, keep the visible message anchor stable during streaming and history paging; at bottom preserve sticky follow. In PTY verify transcript/Shell/list-dialog routing without editor-focus changes, single and fast/reversed ticks, both history edges, and a live stream; measure event-to-paint latency and settle time at 165 Hz and faster requested budgets. No periodic work remains after scrolling settles.

cases.title: Message Revert and original-compatible clickable Redo marker
cases.expected: In a real session with at least three completed user turns, click an earlier delivered user message without selected text and activate Revert in Message Actions. Verify modal dismissal, restored prompt and committed conversation/context boundary hiding multiple user messages, with no workspace/Git changes. Show the upstream-shaped N message(s) reverted block with truthful restorable-user-message count from the durable owner, hover and a keymap-derived restore hint (default ctrl+x r or /redo to restore). In separate action runs, marker click, configured shortcut, /redo and palette Redo must each clear the entire staged boundary, restore the whole saved tail and remove the marker, not restore only one turn. Selected text prevents marker-click restoration; owner failure preserves the boundary/block and reports an error. Verify durable count/boundary after session switch/reopen and invalidation of normal old-tail redo after a new accepted prompt. Restore saved messages/tool pairs/context without provider calls or tool reexecution. Compare full styled-cell/PNG frames with pinned OC2 under snapshots disabled; preserve truthful conversation-only menu wording, never promise file restoration. Pinned source URLs/locators are in U11-U14 and the T44 spec/amendment; older stepwise-Redo reports do not qualify this corrected contract.
